indicators.note: to revise something is to rework it, so the letters of these two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone has some preparation to go over, perhaps.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to revise' shuffles HASPREP into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Both words are everyday adverbs expressing possibility, interchangeable synonyms.

clue.text: There are two points he can possibly raise

parts.note: E (east) is one compass point
N (north) is a second compass point

indicators.note: possibly signals that the letters can be arranged another way

explanation.surface: A man with a couple of spare points might be able to lift his score.
explanation.walkthrough: Two compass points, E and N, are followed by HANCE, which 'possibly' makes from HE CAN.
explanation.definitionFit: To raise something's value or quality is to improve or heighten it, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Quit when there's a strike about work

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the strike word goes round the work word

parts.note: to strike is to hit
OP is short for opus, a musical work

explanation.surface: Downing tools when a strike is called over working conditions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Quit' is a curt order to go away here, not a resignation; 'about' puts the work inside the strike.
explanation.definitionFit: A slangy British imperative telling someone to leave, the same order as the curt command to go.

definitions.meaning: a baseball player who throws the ball to the batter
a jug or vessel for pouring liquid

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both the baseball thrower and a large jug, two unrelated senses.

definitions.meaning: holds on, as when told to stay on the telephone line

explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means both persevering and holding the line or waiting a moment.

clue.text: Eel cooked and covered in oil

indicators.note: cooked means prepared or messed about, so the surrounding letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An eel prepared for the table and drenched in oil.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cooked' stands between its fodder, so the word after it is shuffled along with the eel.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic verb for giving extreme unction, anointing a dying person with holy oil.

clue.text: Fortuitously forgo draw and advance to the next round

indicators.note: fortuitously means by chance, so the letters fall into a random new order

explanation.surface: A team happily avoids a replay and goes through to the next stage of the cup.
explanation.definitionFit: To progress into the following stage of a competition, as a winning team does.

parts.note: read 'Utterly' as 'in utterance': describing a style of speaking that is grandiose and booming

explanation.definitionFit: The adjective describes a voice or speech that is full, round and inflated in its delivery.

parts.note: not the phrase meaning 'unsurprising' but a young child who is a marvel of talent

explanation.definitionFit: A child genius is literally a wonder who is little, a very young prodigy.

definitions.meaning: a thin piece cut or broken off something
in golf, a short lofted shot played onto the green

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a thin piece broken off and a short lofted golf stroke onto the green.

clue.text: Novice nurse employed by the infantry

parts.note: a tender is one who looks after or nurses
foot soldiers are the infantry

explanation.surface: A trainee nurse taken on by an army regiment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'employed by' simply joins the pieces: TENDER followed by FOOT.
explanation.definitionFit: A newcomer or greenhorn lacking experience, originally a raw recruit to frontier life.

definitions.meaning: a short fragment of a tune

explanation.surface: Getting a brief hold of a tune.
explanation.definitionFit: The noun means a sudden grab and also a brief fragment of a song or melody.

clue.text: Urge pa, go around with people of the same generation

indicators.note: around signals that the letters are moved about into a new order

explanation.surface: Children urge their father to go out and mix with his contemporaries.
explanation.definitionFit: A cohort or band of people born in roughly the same years forms one such bracket.

clue.text: Not the cost of living, apparently

definitions.text: Not the cost of living, apparently

parts.words: Not the cost of living, apparently
parts.note: read 'cost of living' as the toll of life against its opposite: a statistical rate of dying rather than of prices

explanation.definitionFit: A mortality statistic, playfully the opposite of a figure measuring expense of living.

definitions.meaning: split as check plus mate: a test is a check and a match is a mate or equal
an international cricket or rugby fixture

explanation.walkthrough: The first definition is cryptic: TEST = check and MATCH = mate. A test match is a full international cricket or rugby fixture.
explanation.definitionFit: A full international fixture, especially a multi-day cricket game between national sides.

parts.note: not a doorman at a gentlemen's club but someone carrying golf clubs

explanation.definitionFit: A golfer's assistant who carries the bag of clubs round the course.

clue.text: One way to get a warning to keep quiet and hide away

parts.note: ST is short for street, a way
sh is the hushing noise asking for silence

explanation.surface: A method of getting someone to stay silent and lie low.
explanation.walkthrough: ST, then A, then SH; 'One' and 'to get' are link words in the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: To store something secretly in a hidden place, a direct verb synonym.

indicators.note: arrangements signals that the letters are set out in a different order

explanation.surface: Temporary plans come to a close.
explanation.definitionFit: Plural of terminus: final points or ends, as of a railway line.

clue.text: They struggled to maintain faith in the past

definitions.text: They struggled to maintain faith in the past

parts.words: They struggled to maintain faith in the past
parts.note: medieval Christian warriors who fought holy wars to uphold their religion

explanation.definitionFit: Medieval knights who campaigned in the Holy Land to defend Christianity.

definitions.meaning: to pull out of a race or contest before it starts
a minor surface wound from claws or a sharp point

explanation.surface: A competitor pulls out with a minor wound.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both pulling out of a contest and a shallow graze on the skin.

parts.note: not a committed party member but a match official who carries yellow and red cards

explanation.definitionFit: The match official in soccer carries yellow and red cards to caution or dismiss players.

definitions.meaning: a thin smear of butter or spread on bread

explanation.surface: Preserve spread very sparingly on toast.
explanation.definitionFit: The noun means both an awkward predicament and a meagre layer of spread on bread.

indicators.note: in signals one piece placed within the other

parts.note: a grid is a grating of bars
mace is the spice from the husk of the nutmeg

explanation.surface: Someone pulled a face while grating nutmeg in the kitchen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'grating' looks like a verb but is the noun for a lattice; 'in' puts the spice inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: To pull a face expressing displeasure or pain, past tense like the definition.

definitions.meaning: read as 'tear away' plus 's for 'is': a phrasal verb meaning to remove by force

explanation.surface: A young hooligan's brazen theft in broad daylight.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrasal verb means pulling something off and the noun means a gross swindle or overcharge.

clue.text: Don, still in bed, gets up

indicators.note: in a down clue, getting up means the letters are read from bottom to top

parts.note: someone still in bed is not up

explanation.surface: A university lecturer is still lying in bed and finally rises.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Don' looks like a university fellow but is the verb to dress in. NOTUP turned round by 'gets up'.
explanation.definitionFit: To don clothes is to dress in them, a verb synonym.

indicators.note: to run is to flow or go about, signalling the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Chinese gangsters rampage out of control.
explanation.walkthrough: 'run wild' reads as one phrase, but 'run' alone shuffles TRIADTHUGS and 'wild' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Being frantic or frenzied with worry or grief, as someone beside themselves is.

definitions.meaning: a pastry dessert with a fruit filling

explanation.surface: A dish that is both sugary and acidic.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a pastry pudding and an adjective for a sharp acidic taste.

parts.note: not a reserve player for a game but a device to make flame in place of a safety match

explanation.definitionFit: A small device producing a flame for cigarettes, used instead of a struck match.

clue.text: Opportunity given to a number in the church

parts.note: a chance is an opportunity
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: A singer from the choir gets a chance to perform in church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'given to' joins the pieces; 'in the' links to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The part of a church near the altar reserved for clergy and choir, one region of the building.
